p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9eacc57a.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 2
    row_breaks = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_breaks = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def segments(n, breaks):
        out=[]; start=0
        for b in breaks:
            if start < b: out.append((start,b))
            start=b+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs, cs = segments(h,row_breaks), segments(w,col_breaks)
    tiles=[[v for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if (v:=grid[r][c]) != sep] for r0,r1 in rs for c0,c1 in cs]
    counts=Counter(v for tile in tiles for v in tile)
    background=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            anomalies=sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != sep for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            row.append(1 if anomalies > 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
